name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/fmf-tools-directory
title: FMF Tools Directory
description: Search 36,650 live-tested MCP servers and 3,548 paid agent APIs on the web, by JSON API or MCP.

tools.name: best_tool_for
tools.description: Find the best verified MCP server and/or pay-per-call API (x402/MPP) for a task, e.g. "web scraping", "token prices", "transcribe audio". Returns ranked picks with live test evidence.

task.description: What the user wants to do

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Keyword search across all MCP servers and paid agent APIs that passed today's tests.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full record for one listing: connection URL, every test result, usage signals, score breakdown.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories with counts and the current best pick in each.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 listings (ids from search_tools/best_tool_for): live status, uptime, latency, tool count, price, auth, license.

tools.name: install_snippet
tools.description: Copy-paste install config for one listing in a given client: claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, vscode, windsurf, gemini-cli, codex, zed (paid APIs: curl / x402-fetch).

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the full deduped index (official MCP Registry, npm, GitHub awesome-lists, x402 Bazaar, MPP catalogs), including entries not yet live-tested. tested=true rows passed our live tests; verification says how each entry is known to be a real MCP server/API (tested, registry, docker-catalog, npm-verified, github-verified, npm-likely, github-topic, npm-name-only, curated-list, payment-indexer).

verified_only.description: only tested, official-registry, Docker-catalog, npm-verified, GitHub-verified or payment-indexer entries
